in_marathi.name: Balraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balraj is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'bal' meaning strength and 'raj' meaning king. It is a powerful name that signifies leadership, courage, and power.
